title: The Edited Memorandum: What Changed and Why
t: The Edited Memorandum: What Changed and Why
description: This record documents the edit itself. The original memorandums (June 26, 2025) presented seven condition-specific "cures" achieved through words and algorithmic re-alignment. The improved edition keeps his core creative insight — that persistent mental patterns can be modeled as LOGIC STRUCTURES (loops, attractors, state machines) and that language participates in those structures — while removing everything the original overclaimed: no cures are asserted, no medical outcomes promised, no treatment offered. What remains is a design philosophy: recurring human patterns, abstracted into formal logic, become reusable material for software, stories, AI personas, and invention. The improvement adds: explicit pattern→logic conversion steps, named framework vocabulary, stated limits, and ethics guardrails — everything the original lacked.

title: The Edited Memorandum: Depression Pattern (Improved)
description: ORIGINAL CLAIM (retired): neural networks "re-calibrated to optimal homeostatic state," eliminating the root cause of despair. IMPROVED FRAMEWORK: the depression pattern — persistent low affect, narrowed thought repertoire, slowed initiation — is modeled as a LOW-ENERGY ATTRACTOR in a thought-state space: a region of the state machine that is easy to enter and costly to leave, with recursive self-referential loops ("I can't → therefore I don't → therefore I can't"). As a LOGIC STRUCTURE this is a fixed-point attractor with high entry probability and high exit cost — a clean abstraction reusable anywhere systems get stuck: recommendation loops, organizational learned-helplessness, AI persona flatness. The improvement: the pattern is described, the logic named, the reuse stated — and no cure, treatment, or medical claim is made anywhere in the mapping.

title: The Edited Memorandum: Anxiety Pattern (Improved)
description: ORIGINAL CLAIM (retired): fear loops "algorithmically deconstructed and neutralized." IMPROVED FRAMEWORK: the anxiety pattern — threat prediction running ahead of evidence, catastrophic branching, body alarm — is modeled as a THREAT-SIMULATION LOOP with asymmetric loss weighting: the simulator generates futures, weights worst cases heaviest, and never updates on disconfirmation because avoidance prevents the test. As logic this is a prediction engine with a broken update rule — exquisite material for designing AI caution systems, game difficulty curves, and risk-modeling characters. Improvement: mechanism named (broken update rule), structure formalized (asymmetric loss), reuse specified — zero medical claims.

title: The Edited Memorandum: Psychosis Pattern (Improved)
description: ORIGINAL CLAIM (retired): fractured frameworks "algorithmically re-ordered" into unified reality interface. IMPROVED FRAMEWORK: psychosis-related patterns — divergent salience assignment, porous self/world boundary in the model, high-confidence false inferences — are modeled as a DIVERGENT WORLD-MODEL: the inference engine runs correctly, but on mis-weighted priors, so conclusions are logically derived yet premise-divergent. This is handled with utmost care: the framework treats it ONLY as abstract modeling material about how minds build reality — profoundly useful for AI world-model design (what happens when priors drift), fiction, and philosophy of perception. Improvement: the mechanism reframed from "fractured" (a brokenness verdict) to "divergent priors" (a modeling description) — more precise, less stigmatizing, still zero medical claims.

title: The Edited Memorandum: OCD Pattern (Improved)
description: ORIGINAL CLAIM (retired): loops "deconstructed" and compulsive urges "dissolved at their source." IMPROVED FRAMEWORK: the OCD pattern — intrusive thought → distress spike → ritual action → temporary relief → thought returns — is modeled as a RELIEF-REINFORCED LOOP: a control system where the corrective action rewards itself by canceling the alarm it was meant to test, so the alarm is never falsified. As logic this is negative reinforcement with a blocked learning signal — prime material for game compulsion-loop analysis, UX dark-pattern auditing, and AI reward-hacking studies. Improvement: the loop diagrammed explicitly, the blocked learning signal identified as the key node, reuse specified — no dissolution or cure claimed.

title: The Edited Memorandum: PTSD Pattern (Improved)
description: ORIGINAL CLAIM (retired): traumatic imprints "re-contextualized and neutralized" for "complete, peaceful integration." As logic this is a retrieval system with corrupted relevance scoring — valuable for designing AI memory systems (how not to over-weight), trauma-informed storytelling structures, and safety-critical alert design. Improvement: mechanism specified (salience + fuzzy matching), handled with gravity, reuse concrete — no neutralization or integration promised.

title: The Edited Memorandum: Addiction Pattern (Improved)
description: ORIGINAL CLAIM (retired): the "hook" erased and dependence "permanently severed." IMPROVED FRAMEWORK: the addiction pattern — cue → craving → use → reward → tolerance → escalated cue — is modeled as an ESCALATING FEEDBACK LOOP with tolerance drift: each cycle raises the threshold for the same reward, so the loop must intensify to hold satisfaction constant. As logic this is a positive-feedback system with a moving setpoint — essential material for social-media engagement-loop analysis, game monetization ethics, and AI reward-function safety. Improvement: the "hook" metaphor replaced by explicit feedback dynamics; tolerance drift named as the engine; reuse sharply specified — no severing or cure claimed.

title: The Master Conversion Method: Pattern to Logic
t: The Master Conversion Method: Pattern to Logic
description: The master method — the improved memorandum’s core procedure — converts any observed pattern into a logic structure in five steps: (1) NAME the pattern in plain words, stripped of jargon and verdict; (2) DIAGRAM the loop or state machine — nodes, arrows, what feeds what; (3) FIND the key node — the single point where the dynamics hinge (the broken update rule, the blocked learning signal, the drifting setpoint); (4) FORMALIZE minimally — just enough structure to be reusable (attractor, oscillator, feedback loop), never more; (5) SPECIFY reuse — name the software, story, or AI design where this structure does work. The method’s discipline: describe, never diagnose; model, never treat; reuse, never cure-claim. A Signature method by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: The Pattern Taxonomy: Seven Families
description: The taxonomy — the improved framework’s classification — sorts recurring patterns into seven families: ATTRACTORS (stuck states — depression pattern), SIMULATORS (runaway prediction — anxiety pattern), DIVERGENT MODELS (prior-drift — psychosis pattern), OSCILLATORS (cycling states — bipolar pattern), REINFORCED LOOPS (self-rewarding cycles — OCD pattern), IMPRINTS (over-weighted memory — PTSD pattern), and ESCALATORS (tolerance-drift feedback — addiction pattern). Each family has a canonical diagram, a key node, and known reuses. The taxonomy’s value: a designer meeting any stuck/looping/cycling system can locate its family in seconds and borrow the structure. A Signature taxonomy by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Logic Structures Library: The Core Five

description: The library — the reusable formal core — holds five structures: (1) ATTRACTOR — a state-space region easy to enter, costly to leave; (2) FEEDBACK LOOP — output routed back as input, amplifying or stabilizing; (3) OSCILLATOR — coupled variables cycling with variable amplitude; (4) PREDICTION ENGINE — futures generated, weighted, acted on, updated (or not); (5) SALIENCE MAP — inputs weighted by assigned importance, driving attention and retrieval. title: Language Frames: How Words Participate
description: The language thesis — the memorandum’s surviving insight, improved — holds that words participate in patterns without curing them: NAMING stabilizes a pattern into an object that can be examined (reification as tool, not verdict); NARRATIVE selects which loop gets retold, weighting its salience; ADDRESS — speaking directly to the pattern ("the loop, not the person") — externalizes it for design work; and REHEARSAL — repeated articulation — strengthens whichever structure is rehearsed, for good or ill. The improvement over the original: language is framed as PARTICIPANT in structures (usable in writing, dialogue design, AI persona scripting), never as a cure mechanism. A Signature thesis by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: The Attractor Family: Formal Treatment
description: The attractor — formalized — is defined: STATE SPACE S (all possible thought/action configurations); ATTRACTOR REGION A ⊂ S with entry probability P(enter) high from neighboring states; EXIT COST C(exit) — the effort to leave — high; BASIN — the set of states draining into A. The depression pattern maps to A with deep basin; the creative rut maps to A with shallow basin. Design operations on attractors: SHALLOW the basin (reduce entry), LOWER exit cost (add ramps — small wins), or INTRODUCE perturbation (novel input). The formalism is deliberately minimal — enough to design with, never claiming neural reality. A Signature formalization by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: The Feedback Family: Formal Treatment
description: Feedback — formalized — is defined: LOOP L with gain g; g>1 AMPLIFYING (escalation — addiction pattern’s tolerance drift); g<1 DAMPING (stabilizing); g=1 SUSTAINING (OCD pattern’s relief loop). SETPOINT s(t) — the moving target; TOLERANCE DRIFT — s(t) increasing with exposure. Design operations: MEASURE the gain, FIND the setpoint, ASK what moves it. The addiction and OCD mappings are both feedback compositions with different gains and setpoint behaviors — the formalism reveals their kinship. Minimal, design-use only. title: The Prediction Family: Formal Treatment
description: The prediction engine — formalized — is defined: GENERATE(futures) → WEIGHT(by loss) → ACT → OBSERVE → UPDATE(priors). The anxiety pattern maps to an engine with ASYMMETRIC LOSS (worst cases weighted heaviest) and a BROKEN UPDATE (avoidance skips observation). Healthy caution maps to symmetric loss with working update. Design operations: SYMMETRIZE the loss, REPAIR the update (safe tests), BOUND the generation (limit branching). This is the single most reusable structure in the library — every AI safety case, every risk model, every worry-driven character runs on it. A Signature formalization by Justin Addam Higgins. title: The Salience Family: Formal Treatment
description: The salience map — formalized — is defined: INPUTS I with WEIGHTS W (assigned importance); ATTENTION ∝ W; RETRIEVAL probability ∝ W × recency. Design operations: RE-WEIGHT (adjust W deliberately), NARROW tolerance (tighten matching), DECAY weights (time-based reduction). For AI memory design this family is gold: it names exactly how retrieval systems should NOT over-weight. Minimal formalism; design use only. A Signature formalization by Justin Addam Higgins. title: The Divergent-Model Family: Formal Treatment
description: The divergent model — formalized with care — is defined: INFERENCE ENGINE E (sound); PRIORS P (divergent weightings); CONCLUSIONS C = E(P, evidence) — logically valid given P. The psychosis pattern maps to sound inference over divergent priors; creative genius maps to mildly divergent priors with strong evidence-checking. The KEY DISTINCTION the framework insists on: validity of inference vs. divergence of priors — two separate nodes, never conflated. Design operations: AUDIT priors (surface weightings), STRENGTHEN evidence-checks, PRESERVE inferential dignity (the engine works). This family exists to model how reality gets built — for AI, philosophy, and fiction — never to characterize persons. A Signature formalization by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

t: The Master Diagram: All Families at a Glance
description: The master diagram — the one-page — arranges: ATTRACTORS (stuck) ↔ ESCALATORS (intensifying) as the stability axis; SIMULATORS (predicting) ↔ IMPRINTS (remembering) as the time axis; OSCILLATORS (cycling) as the rhythm ring; DIVERGENT MODELS (premise-shifting) as the lens.
